lessons.rule: Keep every qualifier (could, expected, estimates, reportedly, if) and name who claims or forecasts, including in headlines and data lines. Never turn a claim, estimate or forecast into a fact, and never move a condition from one statement onto another.

example.wrong: ويوسّع نطاق الانتشار العسكري الأمريكي إلى القطب الشمالي دون تكلفة إضافية على واشنطن.
example.quote: "There will be NO COST to the United States," he wrote.

previous: Keep every qualifier in Arabic: could, possibly, as much as, hopefully, expected, scheduled, will, estimates, reportedly. Name who claims, forecasts or estimates it. Never turn a claim, hope, forecast or reported figure into a stated fact, a present result or a bare headline number.

Keep every qualifier in Arabic: could, possibly, expected, will, estimates, reportedly, if/should it go ahead. Name who claims or forecasts. Never turn a claim, conditional warning, forecast or promise ('no cost') into a stated fact, present result or bare headline.

lessons.rule: Credit each sentence to whom the source credits it. An outlet's background, inference or own tally is not the official's statement; a data firm cited for one figure owns only that figure; a quoted analyst's forecast is not the outlet's view. Add no conclusion nobody drew.

example.wrong: وذكر أنه كان لديه سابقاً 'قيصر للذكاء الاصطناعي' وهو ديفيد ساكس، الذي استقال وأصبح مستشاراً خارجياً للرئيس.
example.quote: Trump already had one “AI czar”, venture capitalist David Sacks. He resigned earlier this year and became an external adviser to the president.

previous: Credit each fact to the party the source credits. Keep the outlet's own background separate from what the speaker said. Name the originating outlet in a chain, such as Politico via Euronews or Reuters data cited by OilPrice. Never invent a spokesperson or an agency.

Credit each fact to whom the source credits; the outlet's own reporting is never 'informed sources', an official statement or analyst data. Name the originating outlet. Never make a reported line a quote, a private notice an announcement, or a reply the decree's aim.

Credit each fact to whom the source credits and name the originating outlet. An outlet's inference ('implying', 'suggesting') is not the official's own statement. An interview is not a statement. Add no conclusion the speaker did not draw.

lessons.rule: Translate financial terms, measures and tenors exactly: the 10-year Treasury is سندات الخزانة لأجل 10 سنوات, real regular pay is not real income, and open interest is العقود المفتوحة. Add no descriptor the source lacks: 'U.S.-led' is not 'private-sector-led'.

example.wrong: ومع بلوغ عائد السندات الأمريكية لأكثر من عشر سنوات مستوى 5.04%، تزداد كلفة إصدار السندات الدولارية التي تموّل مشاريع البنية التحتية في الخليج.
example.quote: بلغ العائد على سندات الخزانة الأمريكية لأجل 10 سنوات 5.04%، مسجلاً أعلى مستوى منذ 2007، بحسب بي بي سي.

previous: Translate financial terms and tenors exactly. The 10-year Treasury is سندات الخزانة لأجل 10 سنوات, not 'more than ten years'. A nominal yield is not 'actual'. Open interest is العقود/المراكز المفتوحة, not interest. Add no descriptor the source lacks.

lessons.rule: Tie each figure to the exact item, place, day and instrument the source's sentence attaches it to. Flows from the broader Middle East are not Hormuz flows, one day's flow is not a daily rate, and diesel is not all fuel.

example.wrong: ترامب يعلن تأسيس قوة للذكاء الاصطناعي وتعيين مسؤول لقيادتها
example.quote: United States President Donald Trump has announced he’s creating an “AI Force” and will appoint a new “AI czar” to oversee development of the nation’s artificial intelligence industry.

previous: Keep a figure or role tied to the exact item, day and instrument the source names. Diesel is not all fuel. One day's count is not a daily rate. A futures-implied value is not the IPO valuation. An official does only what the source assigns.

lessons.rule: Give each action or description to the exact actor the source names. One side calling talks 'successful' is not 'officials' or both sides, market participants are not market infrastructures, and an institution is not a person. Never swap host and guest.

example.wrong: الرئيس الأمريكي دونالد ترامب استضاف الرئيس الصيني شي جين بينغ في بكين في مايو 2026، وهذه الزيارة هي الأولى لشي إلى واشنطن منذ 2015، وفقاً لمصدر من Euronews بتاريخ 2026-09-18.

previous: For visits, hosting, deals and transfers, reread the source's verb to see who acts on whom. 'Trump went to Beijing' means Xi hosted Trump. Check that subject and object have not been swapped before printing.

Give each action to the exact actor the source's verb names. If MPs called for a law after a committee's finding, the committee did not call for it. An institution such as a military headquarters is not a person. Never swap host and guest.

lessons.rule: Take each event's day from the source's sentence about that event, and give that day only to that event. A poll that closed Sunday was not published Sunday, and 'this weekend' is not 'this week'. Convert a weekday by counting back from publication.

example.quote: The Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday issued an order creating a regulatory pathway for certain trading venues to issue tokenized representations of publicly traded U.S. stocks, effective immediately.

previous: Copy the weekday or date of an event from the source's own sentence about that event, not from the publication date or another report. If sources disagree, follow the primary report and do not guess.

Take each event's day from the source's sentence about that event; convert a weekday by counting back from the publication date. Keep an announcement, a takeover, a later remark and a reply on their own days, with any time of day given.

lessons.rule: Copy the names of outlets, companies, people and laws exactly as the source gives them; never swap in an older or more familiar name (MS NOW is not MSNBC). Recheck the name in the headline and at every repetition in the body.

example.wrong: ترامب يحظر سي إن إن وإم إس إن بي سي وبوليتيكو من البيت الأبيض
example.quote: United States President Donald Trump has announced that, effective immediately, CNN, MS NOW and Politico are banned from the White House.

lessons.rule: Copy every number and ranking with its own qualifier. 500 is not 'more than 500', 'nearly 4,000' is not 4,000, and 'one of the most important' is not 'the most important'. Never move a qualifier from one figure onto its neighbour.

example.wrong: كما أن إلغاء أكثر من 500 رحلة وتأخير 4000 أخرى يرفع تكاليف التشغيل على الشركات الجوية ويؤثر على ثقة المسافرين في موثوقية البنية التحتية للنقل الجوي، وهو ما قد يترتب عليه إعادة تقييم لاستثمارات الصيانة والاحتياطي في أنظمة المراقبة الجوية.
example.quote: Throughout the US, there were nearly 4,000 delayed flights and 500 cancelled.

lessons.rule: Explain a price or market move only by the cause the source's own sentence gives it. Never make another report or development from the story the trigger, and add no cause the source does not state.
